Name: Group Chat - Immersive NPC Group Conversations
Author: acharles1
Description:
[center][size=4][b]GROUP CHAT[/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=2]Talk to one villager. Let the whole group join in.[/size][/center]

[center][size=2]Ever walked into a festival and thought:
[i]“Alright... time to click 26 people one by one.”[/i]
Yeah.
[b]No more.[/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=2]With [b]Group Chat[/b], talking to one villager can naturally pull nearby villagers into the conversation, one after another[b].[/b]
So instead of:
click Abigail
walk two steps
click Sebastian
click Sam
squeeze past Pierre
click Caroline
accidentally click a chair
forget who you already talked to...
you can just:
[b]walk up to the group → talk once → hear everyone out[/b]
Much better. 😂[/size][/center]

[heading][size=3]🌱 HOW IT WORKS[/size][/heading]
[size=2]Talk to any villager like normal.[/size]
[size=2]If other villagers are nearby, Group Chat gathers them into the conversation.[/size]
[size=2]Your farmer turns toward each person as they speak, and every villager uses their [b]actual available dialogue[/b] — including daily, contextual, festival, and compatible modded dialogue.[/size]
[size=2]Group Chat continues until each participant has said everything they currently have to say.[/size]
[size=2]Then everyone gets back to their day.[/size]
[size=2]Sometimes with a few little emotes afterward. ❤️[/size]

[heading][size=3]🌻 PERFECT FOR FESTIVALS[/size][/heading]
[size=2]This is where Group Chat really shines.
At the Egg Festival, Flower Dance, Stardew Valley Fair, Spirit’s Eve and other festivals, villagers are already standing around in little social groups.
So now those groups can actually [b]feel like groups[/b].
Walk over to one cluster.
Talk to somebody.
Everyone nearby gets their turn.
No sprinting around Pelican Town’s entire population like you’re doing attendance.
And importantly:
[b]Group Chat only handles conversation.[/b]
It won’t suddenly:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]start the Egg Hunt[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]trigger the Flower Dance[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]launch a competition[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]open a shop[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]advance the festival[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]make choices for you[/size][/*]
[/list][size=2]So you get the convenience [b]without losing control[/b].[/size]

[heading][size=3]✨ FEATURES[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Talk to one villager and nearby villagers can join[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Fully exhausts available safe dialogue so you don't need to run back and click everyone again[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Farmer turns toward whoever is speaking[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Configurable conversation radius from 2–10 tiles[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Protects questions and personal conversations [/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Villagers with something personal to ask show a [b]❓[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Questions are skipped by Group Chat so you can answer them manually[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Safe around gifts, shops, services, spouses, and special interactions[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Small staggered end-of-conversation emotes make groups feel a little more alive[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Quick ON/OFF dialogue button[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Lightweight and interaction-driven — no constant world scanning[/size][/*]
[/list][heading][size=3]❓ PERSONAL CONVERSATIONS[/size][/heading]
[size=2]Sometimes a villager has something they specifically want to ask "you"
Group Chat protects those moments.
If a pending personal question is detected, that villager is excluded from the group conversation and may show a small: [/size]
[size=2]"❓"
above their head.
Talk to them manually and their conversation proceeds normally.
Group Chat never answers questions or makes personal choices for you.[/size]
      

[b][size=3]🔐 TURN IT OFF WHEN YOU WANT SOME PRIVACY[/size][/b]
[size=2]Sometimes you really do just want to talk to [b]one person[/b].
That’s why Group Chat has a small dialogue control:
[b]👥 Coloured group[/b]
Group Chat is ON and nearby villagers can join.
[b]👤 Grey solo[/b]
Group Chat is ON, but nobody nearby is available.
[b]🚫👥 Red-slashed group[/b]
Group Chat is OFF.
Click it whenever you want to switch back to a normal one-on-one conversation.
No menu digging required.[/size]


[b][size=3]❤️ LITTLE SOCIAL MOMENTS[/size][/b]
[size=2]When a successful Group Chat finishes, villagers can react with small staggered emotes afterward.
Nothing dramatic.
Just little:[/size]

[size=2]"❤️♪😊! ..."[/size]
[size=2]
The farmer may react too.
 
These little moments are purely cosmetic, but they help the conversation feel like a shared social moment rather than a sequence of menu boxes.[/size]


[size=3][b]💚 WHY GROUP CHAT?[/b][/size]
[size=2]
Because sometimes the villagers are already standing together.
They already feel like a group.
Now talking to them can feel like one too.[/size]

   

[left][b]📦 Requirements[/b][/left]
[left][size=2]·       [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b][/size][/left]
[left][size=2]·       [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b][/size][/left]
[left][size=2]·       [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] — Optional[/size][/left]
